selection.rationale: Highest score: iconic piano-glissando opening, positive energy development into the first chorus, strong climax in the last 40%, ends on a downbeat 1.2 s from a structural boundary. Runner-up (97.8-163.9 s) starts louder but has no development.

cue_sheet.visual: Camera cranes down from the night sky over Gary steel mills to the house
Window lights up; brothers dance in silhouette; location card
Push through the window into the living room (flash)
Dancers lock into unison step-touch
Group point-hit introduces the five brothers; camera push + shake
Spin -> whip pan to the club
Club stage: Michael shy at the mic
Spotlight snaps onto Michael; he sings with confidence
Audience wakes up (bounce, hands up); brothers step-touch
Curtains close on the beat and reopen in the grand theater
Vinyl record drops; tonearm lands
Recording studio; VU meters ride the real audio
Close-up: Michael singing (lip movement from vocal envelope)
Producers jump up, thumbs up
Record turns gold, colour explosion builds
White flash into the 1969 TV stage, op-art backdrop
Tracking shot follows Michael sliding across the stage
Return slide + kick, point hit
Silhouette sequence against the orange sun disc
Close-up on Michael singing, spin
Match cut on Michael's face into the arena; pull back
Group revealed; unison step-touch
Wide arena: thousands of fans, beams
Spin + point hit (camera shake)
Golden lights, knee drop, title THE JACKSON 5
Subtitle: A story of five brothers who changed music forever.
